title: The Classic Adventure Fantasy 『Cloudsea Odyssey』 Is Complete!!

blocks.source: 王道冒険ファンタジー『雲海のオデッセイ』完結！！
blocks.translation: The Classic Adventure Fantasy 『Cloudsea Odyssey』 Is Complete!!

blocks.source: 王道冒険ファンタジー『雲海のオデッセイ』完結（2020/09/19）しました。
blocks.translation: The classic adventure fantasy 『Cloudsea Odyssey』 was completed (2020/09/19).

blocks.source: 予定通り約１７０万字。合計４４１話の大作になりました。
blocks.translation: As planned, it is approximately 1.7 million characters long. It became an epic work spanning 441 episodes in total.

blocks.source: 小説という初めての経験でしたが、無事に満足の行く作品に仕上げられたと思います。
blocks.translation: Writing a novel was a first-time experience for me, but I think I was able to successfully turn it into a satisfying work.

blocks.source: キャラクター性を重視した作風なんかは、作者的にかなり思い切ったなあという感じです。今時の小説でそれをやらないほうがレアですが。今までゲーム作家としては無口主人公ばかりを書いていたもので……。
blocks.translation: Making character personality such a strong focus was quite a bold choice for me as an author. Though these days, not doing that in a novel would be the unusual choice. As a game writer, I had only written silent protagonists until now...

blocks.source: 主人公とヒロインのやり取りの多さなんか、過去の作品には絶対になかったことですね。特に色々と濃いヒロインが書けたと思います。今後の作品にも活かしていきたいところです。
blocks.translation: The amount of interaction between the protagonist and heroine was something that had absolutely never appeared in my previous works. In particular, I think I was able to write heroines with very distinctive personalities. I would like to put this experience to use in future works.

blocks.source: というわけで、本気で自分なりに王道冒険ファンタジーを書いたので、興味がおありの方はどうぞ。全部読むと５０時間とか普通にかかります。ガチです。でも、ダラダラ戦闘を引っ張るとかそういうことはしていません。
blocks.translation: So, I seriously wrote a classic adventure fantasy in my own style. If you are interested, please give it a try. Reading the whole thing normally takes around 50 hours. Seriously. But I did not pad it out with drawn-out battles or anything like that.

blocks.source: https://ncode.syosetu.com/n0109fq/
blocks.translation: https://ncode.syosetu.com/n0109fq/

blocks.source: ちなみに、自分はタブレットのアプリを使って電子書籍っぽく読んでいます。最近は紙の本をあまり読まなくなりました。物理的に場所を取らなくてありがたいことです。
blocks.translation: By the way, I read it using a tablet app in an e-book-like format. Recently, I have not been reading many physical books. It is nice not having them take up physical space.

blocks.source: 今後の活動について
blocks.translation: Future Activities

blocks.source: なろう内の活動報告とやや重複しますが、こちらにも今後の活動予定を書こうと思います。
blocks.translation: This overlaps somewhat with my activity report on Narō, but I would like to write about my plans for future activities here as well.

blocks.source: さて、めでたく１０月から僕はニートになります。
blocks.translation: Well then, as of October, I will happily become a NEET.

blocks.source: しかもただのニートではなく永久ニートです。
blocks.translation: And not just an ordinary NEET, but a permanent NEET.

blocks.source: 英語で言えばエターナルニートです。
blocks.translation: In English, you could call it an eternal NEET.

blocks.source: 今後、基本的には会社勤めを辞めて、自分の趣味と創作に専念する予定です。
blocks.translation: From now on, I basically plan to quit working for a company and devote myself to my hobbies and creative work.

blocks.source: これはガチです。止めても無駄です。
blocks.translation: I am completely serious. There is no point trying to stop me.

blocks.source: ※小遣い稼ぎや人恋しさでちょっと働くことはあるかもしれませんが、細かいことは気にしないでください。
blocks.translation: ※I may work a little now and then to earn some pocket money or because I miss being around people, but please do not worry about the details.

blocks.source: 創作一本で食っていく――のは多分難しいので、普通に働いて、普通に節約して、普通に貯金して、普通に投資して得た蓄えと利益で生きていく予定です。
blocks.translation: Making a living solely from creative work would probably be difficult, so I plan to live off the savings and profits I accumulate by working normally, cutting expenses normally, saving normally, and investing normally.

blocks.source: 面白みはないけれど、たぶんそれが一番確実だと思います。少なくとも、飛び抜けた才能と努力と運がない限りは。
blocks.translation: It is not very exciting, but I think that is probably the most reliable approach. At least without exceptional talent, effort, and luck.

blocks.source: というわけで、次は王道雲海ＲＰＧを作成する予定です。
blocks.translation: So, next I plan to create a classic cloudsea RPG.

blocks.source: 雲海のオデッセイの続編とかではなく、あくまで世界設定が類似しているだけの別作品になります。
blocks.translation: It will not be a sequel to Cloudsea Odyssey, but an entirely separate work whose world setting merely bears similarities to it.

blocks.source: そのほうが新規のユーザにも入ってもらいやすいし、作者としても制作の自由度も上がるのではないかと。
blocks.translation: That should make it easier for new users to get into, and it should also give me, as the author, greater creative freedom.

blocks.source: 市販だとワイルドアームズやメタルマックスといった作品が、シリーズで世界設定を共有している例ですね。『荒野の世界』『文明崩壊後の世界』という設定を共有してはいても、世界自体は作品毎に別物――とまあ、そんな感じです。
blocks.translation: Among commercial games, Wild Arms and Metal Max are examples of series that share a world setting. Even though they share settings such as “a world of wilderness” and “a world after the collapse of civilization,” the worlds themselves are separate for each work—that is the general idea.

blocks.source: ツールはたぶんツクールＭＺになります。
blocks.translation: The tool will probably be RPG Maker MZ.

blocks.source: 既に色々とプラグインを作成していますが、全てはこの準備と言っても過言ではありません。
blocks.translation: I have already created various plugins, and it would not be an exaggeration to say that all of them are preparation for this.

blocks.source: ツクール２０００時代とは機能が桁違いなので、どのように世界やシステムを表現するか楽しみでなりません。
blocks.translation: Its capabilities are on an entirely different level from the RPG Maker 2000 era, so I cannot wait to see how I will portray the world and systems.

blocks.source: でも、基本的には２０００時代と同じ解像度のドット絵を使用するつもりです。町人、敵、マップチップ、効果音などはミスティックスターを流用しながら追加していきます。
blocks.translation: However, I basically intend to use pixel art at the same resolution as in the RPG Maker 2000 era. I will continue adding townspeople, enemies, map tiles, sound effects, and so on while reusing assets from Mystic Star.

blocks.source: そのほうが差別化もできるし、現実的に描くのも楽ですからね。
blocks.translation: That will help differentiate it, and it will also make it easier to draw everything realistically.

blocks.source: いくつになろうとも、ＳＦＣ万歳です。
blocks.translation: No matter how old I get, long live the SFC.

blocks.source: 制作期間は当然年単位になる予定です。でも、ミスティックスターよりは短くしたい。かつてよりもあらゆる条件はよくなったので、理論上はかなり期間を縮められるはず。
blocks.translation: The development period will naturally be measured in years. However, I want it to be shorter than Mystic Star. Since every condition is better than it was before, I should theoretically be able to shorten the development time considerably.

blocks.source: というか、そうあって欲しい。じゃないと、僕の寿命が尽きてしまいそうです。
blocks.translation: Or rather, I hope that will be the case. Otherwise, I feel like I will run out of lifespan before it is finished.

blocks.source: これだけでスキルの実装は、半分ぐらいの時間まで短縮できるんじゃないかと予想しています。
blocks.translation: I predict that this alone will reduce the time required to implement skills to around half.

blocks.source: こんな感じでアニメーションもモーションも自由自在です。
blocks.translation: With animation and motion like this, I can customize them freely.

blocks.source: フリーにするか販売にするかは未定です。でも、今後はニートなので収入源は欲しいと思っています。
blocks.translation: I have not decided whether to release it for free or sell it. However, since I will be a NEET from now on, I would like to have a source of income.

blocks.source: それでは、今後ともよろしくお願いします！
blocks.translation: Thank you for your continued support!

blocks.source: ※……決意表明っぽいことを書きましたが、せっかくのニートです。しばらく積ゲーと積本の消化を優先することをお許しください。
blocks.translation: ※...I wrote something resembling a declaration of intent, but being a NEET is a rare opportunity. Please forgive me for prioritizing working through my backlog of games and books for a while.

lines.source: 特に[[LINK_1]]DynamicAnimation&Motionプラグイン[[/LINK_1]]は、かつて苦労した戦闘アニメの実装を劇的に強化＆楽にしてくれる逸品です。

parts.source: は、かつて苦労した戦闘アニメの実装を劇的に強化＆楽にしてくれる逸品です。

lines.translation: In particular, the [[LINK_1]]DynamicAnimation&Motion Plugin[[/LINK_1]] is an excellent tool that dramatically enhances and simplifies the implementation of battle animations, which used to be a challenge.
